llm_response.reason: The domain 'fb-business.com' is not affiliated with Meta/Facebook and mimics official business support infrastructure to deceive users. Numerous reports indicate a surge in phishing scams targeting Facebook page owners using similarly constructed fake support domains. Characteristics present include spoofing of legitimate support services, urgency/psychological pressure, intent to harvest account credentials, and technical obfuscation (privacy, restrictive access). Official company communications would occur via facebook.com/meta.com domains only.
